snippet.title: Pro Jank Footy | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game where Aussie Rules gets rogue. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.
